practice-double-v1.statement: Calculate \(\iint_D \left(\frac{1}{x^{2} + y^{2}}\right)\,dA,\quad D = \left\{(x,y) : 1 \le x^{2}+y^{2} \le e^{2}\right\}\quad\text{(polar coordinates)}\).

practice-triple-v1.statement: Calculate \(\iiint_E \left(- x^{2} - y^{2}\right)\,dV,\quad E = \left\{x^{2}+y^{2} \le 1,\ 0 \le z \le 3\right\}\quad\text{(cylindrical coordinates)}\).

practice-partial-v1.statement: Calculate \(\frac{\partial}{\partial z}\left(- x y^{2} z^{3}\right)\quad(x, y, z \in \mathbb{R})\).
steps: x, y\ \text{constant}:\quad \frac{\partial}{\partial z}\left(- x y^{2} z^{3}\right) = - 3 x y^{2} z^{2}

practice-partial-v1.statement: Calculate \(\frac{\partial^2}{\partial x\,\partial y}\left(3 x^{2} e^{x y}\right)\quad(x, y \in \mathbb{R})\).
steps: x\ \text{constant}:\quad \frac{\partial}{\partial y}\left(3 x^{2} e^{x y}\right) = 3 x^{3} e^{x y}
y\ \text{constant}:\quad \frac{\partial}{\partial x}\left(3 x^{3} e^{x y}\right) = 3 x^{2} \left(x y + 3\right) e^{x y}
\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial y\,\partial x} = 3 x^{2} \left(x y + 3\right) e^{x y}

practice-partial-v1.statement: Calculate \(f = z \left(x + y\right),\quad x = r \cos{\left(\theta \right)},\ y = r \sin{\left(\theta \right)}:\quad \frac{\partial f}{\partial \theta}\ \text{in}\ r, \theta, z\quad(r > 0,\ \theta, z \in \mathbb{R})\).
steps: x = r \cos{\left(\theta \right)},\quad y = r \sin{\left(\theta \right)},\quad z = z

\frac{\partial f}{\partial x} = z,\ \frac{\partial x}{\partial \theta} = - r \sin{\left(\theta \right)};\quad \frac{\partial f}{\partial y} = z,\ \frac{\partial y}{\partial \theta} = r \cos{\left(\theta \right)};\quad \frac{\partial f}{\partial z} = x + y,\ \frac{\partial z}{\partial \theta} = 0

\frac{\partial f}{\partial \theta} = \frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\frac{\partial x}{\partial \theta} + \frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\frac{\partial y}{\partial \theta} + \frac{\partial f}{\partial z}\frac{\partial z}{\partial \theta} = - r z \sin{\left(\theta \right)} + r z \cos{\left(\theta \right)}
